description: Powerful Performance: Equipped with 12GB RAM and 256GB storage for seamless multitasking and ample space for apps, photos, and videos. Next-Gen 5G Connectivity: Experience ultra-fast downloads, smooth streaming, and uninterrupted browsing with advanced 5G support. Stunning AMOLED Display: Enjoy immersive visuals with a high refresh rate for smooth, vibrant viewing of videos, games, and apps. AI-Enhanced Triple Camera: Capture every detail in vivid clarity with a versatile camera system optimized for any lighting condition. All-Day Battery & Security: Stay productive with a long-lasting battery and advanced features like in-display fingerprint sensor and facial recognition.
